usedFor: Worksection holds projects and tasks, and Google Drive copies or shares a file for them via “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Worksection, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new project can start with its own copy of a file, placed in a selected folder and optionally renamed.

watchOut: Worksection triggers such as “New Project” are polling, so “Copy a File” follows a scheduled check.
